scope: Native Entity.calculateViewVector, every state of the 12 audited cube outlines and BlockGetter.clip with native OUTLINE/NONE/empty CollisionContext. Includes ties, inside hits, near edges and tiny/zero rays. Does not establish general legacy outline support, fluids/entities or server targeting authority.
context: Legacy ClipContext has no empty-entity constructor: reflection initializes its five data fields with native vectors/enums/empty CollisionContext. calculateViewVector is called on an uninitialized concrete ArmorStand because that pure method reads no entity fields. Traversal, clipping and shape methods run unmodified.
